changes: Advanced Mode now uses the chords of real music. The chords of the key come most often; secondary dominants, chords borrowed from the minor and diminished sevenths come less often.
New “Random key” choice: each question gets its own key signature, up to six sharps or flats.
9th chords are always in root position, so they no longer turn into note clusters.
New “?” button: it shows this list of changes.
New home button to go back to the Kids Portal.
Sharper and larger staff on iPad.
Sharps, flats and naturals sit on the correct line in every browser.
The white key is now a correct answer for C♭, F♭, E♯ and B♯.
Fixed a crash with 9th chords in the bass clef.
First version: notes and chords on the treble or bass staff, 13 key signatures, piano or letter buttons.
